author: MunchlaxSB
body:
MalaNala has been insulting me several times recently. I told her numerous times to stop but she didn't care.

Here is the evidence: http://imgur.com/a/eyPlY

She said some things in global chat and some in /msg. PLEASE DO SOMETHING. I can't play on this server when MalaNala is around, she's always offending me!

PS: She only insulted me when no moderators were online and when moderators were online, she used /msg. What a nasty woman, especially coming from her? I can't believe it.
